name: Nidwalden
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Nidwalden
summary: A red square with a white double key: two keys back to back with their bits pointing outward.
origin: Nidwalden shares the key of Saint Peter with Obwalden; the two formed Unterwalden, one of the three founding cantons.

symbols.name: Double key
symbols.description: Two white keys joined back to back.

facts: Its keys are the keys of heaven held by Saint Peter.
clues: A white double key on red.
Half of a founding canton, sharing a key symbol with its twin.
